event: Financial threshold increased; announced December 7 2023
affected_cohort: New study permit applicants
measured_number: CAD 20635 living expenses plus first-year tuition and travel
mechanism: Higher funds needed may constrain affordability
evidence_strength: Verified policy; demand effect not quantified
quote: This change was implemented for all new study permit applications received on or after January 1, 2024.
limitations: Pre-PAL accompanying reform; not proof of lower application demand

event: PAL requirement and two-year cap introduced
affected_cohort: Most new college and undergraduate applicants; masters/doctoral and K-12 exempt
measured_number: Approximately 360000 initial planned new permits
mechanism: Application capacity limit and new prerequisite before permit application
quote: Those pursuing master’s and doctoral degrees, and elementary and secondary education are not included in the cap.
limitations: Initial headline was revised; no six-year PAL series exists; applications already received exempt

event: Longer PGWP available for eligible shorter masters degrees
affected_cohort: Masters graduates from programs shorter than two years
measured_number: 3-year PGWP
mechanism: Could improve attractiveness of masters study
quote: a longer, 3-year post-graduation work permit will be available
limitations: Subject to all other eligibility criteria; a positive incentive alongside restrictions

event: Alberta issues first PALs after February29 institutional allocations
affected_cohort: Alberta publicly funded DLIs initially prioritized
measured_number: First letters March1; allocations reflect2023permits with modest growth where possible
mechanism: Implementation timing matters between federal announcement and provincial availability
quote: issued the first letters on March 1, 2024
limitations: Not evidence of exact applications delayed; initially publicly funded cohort represented over95% of provincial international enrolment per report

event: Initial spouse open-work-permit eligibility restricted
affected_cohort: Spouses/common-law partners of international students
measured_number: Eligibility limited to graduate degrees; eligible pilots; selected professional degrees
mechanism: Reduces family work option for most undergraduate/college applicants
quote: On March 19, 2024, IRCC implemented restrictions on open work permit eligibility
limitations: Distinct from additional16-month masters restriction effectiveJanuary21,2025; no measured causal share

event: Final provincial allocations and top-ups published
affected_cohort: 2024 capped cohorts
measured_number: Alberta 40894 application spaces and 24537 expected permits
mechanism: Allowance for refusal through applications exceeding permit target
limitations: Not actual permits or arrivals; initial Alberta population allocation 45824 was superseded

event: PGWP eligibility removed for new public-private curriculum licensing college cohorts
affected_cohort: Students beginning affected college programs
measured_number: Implementation accelerated from September 1 to May 15
mechanism: Reduced post-study work option could lower demand for affected programs
evidence_strength: Verified policy; university impact cannot be generalized
quote: This change will take effect on May 15, 2024
limitations: Contemporaneous March22 notice uses on-or-after May15; current eligibility page uses after May15; edge-date discrepancy retained

event: 2025 target reduction and wider reforms announced
affected_cohort: Study permit applicants; prospective graduate and family cohorts
measured_number: 437000 permits for 2025
mechanism: Further restrictions and forthcoming rule changes may affect recruitment decisions
quote: For 2025, this means reducing study permits issued to 437,000
limitations: Announcement date; later implementation dates govern; 437000 includes more than PAL-required new arrivals

event: PGWP language and eligible-field rules take effect
affected_cohort: Most PGWP applicants; new study applicants to college or shorter non-degree university programs
measured_number: CLB7 university graduates; CLB5 college graduates; eligible fields for specified non-degree cohorts
mechanism: Changes expected return from study for affected programs
evidence_strength: Verified policy; effect on admissions unmeasured
quote: new study permit applicants intending to pursue college or certain shorter university programs
limitations: Bachelor/master/doctoral degrees exempt from field restriction; do not claim all university programs lose PGWP

event: DLI-change permit rule and 24-hour off-campus work limit effective
affected_cohort: Students changing schools; eligible off-campus workers; DLIs
measured_number: 24 hours/week during study periods
mechanism: Additional permit step for transfers; work allowance may partly offset financial pressures
quote: Increasing the number of hours an eligible international student can work off campus each week from 20 hours to 24 hours
limitations: November15 news release is publication date; rule is not a measured PAL shortfall cause

event: SDS and Nigeria Student Express closed
affected_cohort: Applicants formerly eligible for expedited streams
measured_number: 14 SDS countries plus Nigeria scheme
mechanism: Processing route changes may affect timing and applicants' expectations
evidence_strength: Verified policy; net demand effect unmeasured
quote: initiatives have ended as of 2:00 p.m. ET today.
limitations: Earlier eligible applications grandfathered; regular study permit route remains

event: Family open-work-permit eligibility narrowed
affected_cohort: Spouses of masters students in shorter programs especially
measured_number: Masters program minimum 16 months; doctoral and specified professional programs eligible
mechanism: Family employment option changes could affect applicants with spouses
quote: master’s programs that are 16 months or longer
limitations: Not a ban on all student spouses; preserve eligible exceptions

event: 2025 PAL scope and cap legally take effect
affected_cohort: Masters/doctoral and other in-scope applications; listed exemptions retained
measured_number: 550162 maximum in-scope applications January22–December31,2025
mechanism: Cohort expansion creates break in PALseries
quote: These Instructions take effect on January 22, 2025
limitations: January24notice is explanatory publication; Jan1–21transition governed by preceding cap instructions

event: Calgary reports prior-year application decline and unused PALs
affected_cohort: University of Calgary international applicants in 2024
measured_number: Approximately 40% application decline; exact PAL use undisclosed
mechanism: University attributes weaker applications and underuse to visa/PAL process
quote: the University was not able to use up its 2024 allocation of PALs.
limitations: No numerical institutional utilization rate; meeting reports 2024; anticipated2025graduate split not final allocation

event: 2025 provincial allocations published; scope effective January22
affected_cohort: Masters/doctoral; most in-Canada applicants; continuing same-DLI same-level renewals exempt
measured_number: Alberta 47338 spaces including 5256 graduate; expected 32660 permits
mechanism: Graduate inclusion changes denominator and mix; unused spaces cannot roll over
quote: DLIs, provinces and territories cannot carry over unused allocation spaces or PAL/TALs from the previous cap year.
limitations: Other PAL-required cohort includes more than university undergraduates; graduate spaces combine masters and doctoral

event: Toronto reports all 2024 allocation used
affected_cohort: University of Toronto international applicants
measured_number: 100% as qualitative all-used statement; counts not supplied here
mechanism: Shows institution variation; policy uncertainty may coexist with full use
quote: the University used all of our 2024 allocation of PALs.
limitations: Meaning of used not defined at application/issuance stage; not proof every PAL led to arrival

event: Living-funds threshold adjusted
affected_cohort: Study permit applicants outside Quebec
measured_number: CAD 22895 excluding tuition/travel
mechanism: Higher funds requirement may constrain applicants
evidence_strength: Verified contemporaneous IRCC QP note; contradictory dynamic page
limitations: QP note gives Sept1; dynamic financial page later labels Jan1,2025. Use contemporaneous date and preserve discrepancy

event: 2026 allocations announced
affected_cohort: PAL-required cohorts; all-permit planning includes exempt cohorts
measured_number: Alberta 32271 spaces; 21582 expected PAL-required permits; Canada 408000 total permits
mechanism: Smaller allocation and changed cohort make year comparisons non-equivalent
limitations: Expected issuance not actual2026 utilization; 155000 new arrivals and253000 extensions are national planning split

event: Public-DLI masters and doctoral students PAL-exempt again
affected_cohort: Degree-granting masters/doctoral programs at public institutions
measured_number: No PAL required for eligible cohort
mechanism: Graduate recruitment becomes less constrained by provincial PAL spaces
quote: you don’t need a provincial or territorial attestation letter
limitations: Does not apply to every graduate certificate or private institution; lower PAL counts need not mean fewer graduate admissions

event: OAG findings reproduced in committee briefing
affected_cohort: Postsecondary application cohorts through September2025
measured_number: Lower volumes and approval yield; 23/51 sampled financial refusals had unclear expected documents
mechanism: Observed shortfall; reasons for approval decline remain unresolved
quote: The department did not know why approval rates were lower than projected.
limitations: Briefing date; not original audit release date. Audit excludes K-12 and tracks application receipt cohorts

event: Latest living-funds threshold applies
affected_cohort: Applicants outside Quebec
measured_number: CAD 23448 for one person excluding tuition/travel
mechanism: Potential affordability channel; too recent for complete outcome evaluation
quote: If you apply on or after September 1, 2026
limitations: Dynamic page; no causal estimate; most collected2026student counts endJuly so predate this event
